mapper.insert: MERGE INTO USER_API_KEYS target USING (SELECT #{userId} AS user_id FROM dual) src ON (target.user_id = src.user_id) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET encrypted_key = #{encryptedKey}, iv_salt = #{ivSalt}, is_active = 'Y', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( user_id, encrypted_key, iv_salt, is_active, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{encryptedKey}, #{ivSalt}, 'Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT key_id, user_id, encrypted_key, iv_salt, is_active, created_at, updated_at FROM USER_API_KEYS WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_active = 'Y'
